name: EDUSPEC
recent: EDUSPEC 近期主要出现董事与主要股东的股权变动公告，包括 CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee 在公开市场及闭市期间的多次增持。公司也多次就 Warrant C 转换普通股发布附加上市公告，已发行股本随之增加。最新季度业绩（截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日）已公布，但资料未提供具体数字。
notable: CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee acquired EDUSPEC shares on multiple dates in October and November 2026.。
Warrant C (2023/2028) conversions into ordinary shares were completed and listed on several dates in late October and early November 2026.。
The company announced its quarterly report for the financial period ended 31 August 2026.。
risks: Repeated conversions of Warrant C into new ordinary shares increase the company's issued share capital.。
The CEO acquired shares during the closed period after announcing an intention to deal.。

recent_en: EDUSPEC recently saw a series of director and substantial shareholder interest changes, including multiple acquisitions by CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee in the open market and during the closed period. The company also issued several additional listing announcements for conversions of Warrant C into ordinary shares, increasing its issued share capital. The latest quarterly results for the period ended 31 Aug 2026 were released, but no specific figures were provided.
notable_en: CEO Dato' Sri Gan Chow Tee acquired EDUSPEC shares on multiple dates in October and November 2026.
Conversions of Warrant C (2023/2028) into ordinary shares were completed and listed on several dates in late October and early November 2026.
The company announced its quarterly report for the financial period ended 31 August 2026.

The CEO acquired shares during the closed period after announcing an intention to deal.
